name: next
change: Next.js 16 removed synchronous access to cookies() and the other request APIs, so the cookie store must now be awaited.
rule: Always await cookies() from next/headers before reading values; synchronous access no longer works.
task: Write a Next.js Server Action that reads the `session` cookie and returns its value, or null when the cookie is not set.
verified: next@16.4.2 dist/server/request/cookies.d.ts declares `cookies(): Promise<ReadonlyRequestCookies>` with no UnsafeUnwrapped sync overload; bundled dist/docs upgrading/version-16.md says synchronous access is fully removed. Blog date 2025-10-21 (npm 16.0.0 published 2025-10-22T00:12Z).

name: vite
change: Vite 8.1 deprecated the WebSocket connection options under server.hmr in favor of the new server.ws option.
rule: Configure dev-server WebSocket connection options under server.ws; protocol, host, port and clientPort under server.hmr are deprecated.
task: Write a Vite config as the default export for a dev server behind a TLS reverse proxy, so the browser's live-reload connection goes to `dev.example.com` on port 443 over wss.
verified: vite@8.3.4 dist/node/index.d.ts: HmrOptions.protocol/host/port/clientPort/path/timeout/server each tagged `@deprecated Use server.ws.* instead`, and interface WsOptions exists. Present since 8.1.0; CHANGELOG 8.1.0 (2026-06-23): 'rename server.hmr options to server.ws options (#21357)'. Config docs: 'are deprecated. Use server.ws instead. These options are automatically synced, so existing configurations will continue to work.'

wrong: export default { server: { hmr: { overlay: false, clientPort: 443, protocol: 'wss' } } }
right: export default { server: { hmr: { overlay: false }, ws: { clientPort: 443, protocol: 'wss', host: 'dev.example.com' } } }

name: tailwindcss
change: Tailwind CSS 4.2.0 deprecated the start-* and end-* utilities in favor of inset-s-* and inset-e-*.
rule: Use inset-s-* and inset-e-* for logical inline positioning; the start-* and end-* utilities are deprecated.
task: Write a TypeScript function that returns the Tailwind class string for an absolutely positioned close button, 1rem from the top and 1rem from the trailing edge of its card, so it flips sides automatically in right-to-left layouts.
verified: CHANGELOG 4.2.0 (2026-02-18), section Deprecated: 'Deprecate start-* and end-* utilities in favor of inset-s-* and inset-e-*' (#19613). tailwindcss@4.3.3 dist/lib.js registers inset-s and inset-e and still registers end (deprecated, not removed).

wrong: export const closeButton = () => 'absolute top-4 end-4 p-2'
export function cls(): string { return 'absolute top-4 md:end-4' }
export const closeButton = () => 'absolute top-4 end-[1rem] rounded'
right: export const closeButton = () => 'absolute top-4 inset-e-4 p-2'
export function cls(): string { return 'absolute top-4 md:inset-e-4' }
export const closeButton = () => 'absolute top-4 inset-e-[1rem] justify-end rounded'

name: zod
change: Zod 4.4.0 deprecated CUID v1 validation with z.cuid() in favor of z.cuid2().
rule: Validate CUID-format ids with z.cuid2(); z.cuid() is deprecated.
task: Write a Zod schema for an `Order` with a numeric `total` and an `id` holding the collision-resistant identifiers from the paralleldrive library; use Zod's built-in format validator for `id`, not a custom regex.
verified: zod@4.6.7 v4/classic/schemas.d.ts: `cuid()` is `@deprecated ... Use z.cuid2() instead`; `export declare function cuid2(...)` present. Release notes v4.4.0: 'CUID v1 is now deprecated' (#5880). The old function still exists.

wrong:
import { z } from 'zod'
export const Order = z.object({ id: z.cuid(), total: z.number() })

import { z } from 'zod'
export const Order = z.object({ id: z.string().cuid(), total: z.number() })
right:
import { z } from 'zod'
export const Order = z.object({ id: z.cuid2(), total: z.number() })

name: @prisma/client
change: Prisma ORM 7 removed the datasources and datasourceUrl client options and requires a driver adapter (or accelerateUrl) when constructing PrismaClient.
rule: Construct PrismaClient with a driver adapter, as in new PrismaClient({ adapter }); never use datasourceUrl, datasources or an empty constructor.
task: Write a module that creates and exports a Prisma Client connected to our Postgres database, using the connection string from the `DATABASE_URL` environment variable.
verified: @prisma/client@7.10.1 runtime/client.d.ts PrismaClientOptions has `adapter: SqlDriverAdapterFactory` / `accelerateUrl`, docs comment says a driver adapter is required; no datasourceUrl or datasources option remains. Upgrade guide shows the before/after. npm 7.0.0 published 2025-11-19.

wrong:
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'
export const prisma = new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: process.env.DATABASE_URL })

import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'
export const prisma = new PrismaClient({ datasources: { db: { url: process.env.DATABASE_URL } } })

import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'
export const prisma = new PrismaClient()

name: eslint
change: ESLint 10 removed support for the old eslintrc configuration format, leaving flat config as the only format.
rule: Write ESLint configuration in flat format with defineConfig, files and languageOptions; eslintrc keys such as env, overrides and root no longer work.
task: Write our ESLint configuration as the default export for a browser JavaScript project: enable the recommended rules, warn on console calls, and turn off no-unused-vars for files under `test/`.
verified: eslint@10.13.0 lib/eslint/ contains only eslint.js, eslint-helpers.js, index.js, worker.js (no legacy-eslint.js) and lib/cli-engine/ no longer has cli-engine.js; package exports './config' -> lib/config-api.js exporting defineConfig. Migration guide section 'Old config format no longer supported'. Release v10.0.0 2026-02-06: 'feat!: remove eslintrc support (#20037)'.

right:
import js from '@eslint/js'
import { defineConfig } from 'eslint/config'
import globals from 'globals'
export default defineConfig([
  js.configs.recommended,
  { languageOptions: { globals: globals.browser }, rules: { 'no-console': 'warn' } },
  { files: ['test/**'], rules: { 'no-unused-vars': 'off' } },
])

import js from '@eslint/js'
import globals from 'globals'
export default [
  js.configs.recommended,
  { languageOptions: { globals: globals.browser } },
  { rules: { 'no-console': 'warn' } },
]

import js from '@eslint/js'
export default [
  js.configs.recommended,
  { rules: { 'no-console': 'warn' } },
  { files: ['test/**/*.js'], rules: { 'no-unused-vars': 'off' } },
]

name: openai
change: OpenAI's Images API deprecated the user parameter in favor of safety_identifier for attributing requests to an end user.
rule: Pass safety_identifier, not user, to identify end users in image generation requests.
task: Using the official OpenAI Node SDK, write a function that generates an image from a prompt on behalf of a signed-in customer, and passes that customer's ID so abusive requests can be attributed to them.
verified: openai@7.39.0 resources/images.d.ts: `user?: string` tagged `@deprecated Deprecated: use safety_identifier instead`; `safety_identifier?` present (5 hits). Absent in 7.35.0, present in 7.36.0. CHANGELOG 7.36.0 dated 2026-10-16 (GitHub release 2026-10-17T00:28Z UTC): 'add safety identifiers to image requests and responses'. Old param still accepted.

wrong:
import OpenAI from 'openai'
const client = new OpenAI()
export const gen = (prompt: string, customerId: string) =>
  client.images.generate({ model: 'gpt-image-1', prompt, user: customerId })
right:
import OpenAI from 'openai'
const client = new OpenAI()
export const gen = (prompt: string, customerId: string) =>
  client.images.generate({ model: 'gpt-image-1', prompt, safety_identifier: customerId })

name: @anthropic-ai/sdk
change: The Anthropic TypeScript SDK marked the Text Completions API as deprecated, pointing callers to the Messages API.
rule: Generate text with client.messages.create; client.completions.create is deprecated.
task: Using the Anthropic TypeScript SDK, write a function that sends a prompt string to Claude and returns the generated text as a string.
verified: @anthropic-ai/sdk@0.137.0 resources/completions.d.ts: Completions.create carries `@deprecated Use the Messages API ... instead`; resources/messages/messages.d.ts present. CHANGELOG 0.132.0 (2026-10-07): 'api: mark the Text Completions API as deprecated'. Note: `latest` on npm is 1.4.0, released within the 14-day window, so it was not used.

name: ai
change: The AI SDK deprecated rawInput on output-error UI message tool parts in favor of input.
rule: Read a failed tool part's arguments from part.input; rawInput is deprecated.
task: Write a TypeScript function that takes a `UIMessage` from the Vercel AI SDK and returns, for each tool part that failed, the tool call ID, the arguments the model passed to the tool, and the error text.
verified: ai@7.0.147 dist/index.d.ts, output-error state: `input: ... | undefined` plus `rawInput?: unknown` tagged `@deprecated Use input instead. This field will be removed in the next major version.` CHANGELOG 7.0.103: 'feat(ai): deprecate rawInput in output-error UI message parts'. npm 7.0.103 published 2026-09-16.

wrong:
import type { UIMessage } from 'ai'
export const failed = (m: UIMessage) => m.parts.flatMap((p: any) => p.state === 'output-error' ? [{ id: p.toolCallId, args: p.rawInput, error: p.errorText }] : [])
right:
import type { UIMessage } from 'ai'
export const failed = (m: UIMessage) => m.parts.flatMap((p: any) => p.state === 'output-error' ? [{ id: p.toolCallId, args: p.input, error: p.errorText }] : [])

name: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
change: MCP TypeScript SDK 1.31.0 deprecated constructing ClientCredentialsProvider and the private-key JWT providers without expectedIssuer.
rule: Always pass expectedIssuer when constructing ClientCredentialsProvider.
task: Write a TypeScript MCP client that connects to `https://mcp.example.com/mcp` over Streamable HTTP and authenticates machine-to-machine with an OAuth client ID and secret from environment variables; our authorization server is `https://auth.example.com`.
verified: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.32.1 dist/esm/client/auth-extensions.d.ts: constructor overload with required `expectedIssuer: string` plus `@deprecated Pass expectedIssuer so the credentials are only sent to that authorization server.` Release 1.31.0 upgrade notes state the deprecation. Old form still compiles.

wrong:
import { ClientCredentialsProvider } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/auth-extensions.js'
const authProvider = new ClientCredentialsProvider({ clientId: process.env.ID!, clientSecret: process.env.SECRET! })

const p = new ClientCredentialsProvider({ clientId: id, clientSecret: secret })
const issuerUrl = 'https://auth.example.com'
right:
import { ClientCredentialsProvider } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/auth-extensions.js'
const authProvider = new ClientCredentialsProvider({ clientId: process.env.ID!, clientSecret: process.env.SECRET!, expectedIssuer: 'https://auth.example.com' })

const expectedIssuer = 'https://auth.example.com'
const p = new ClientCredentialsProvider({ clientId: id, clientSecret: secret, expectedIssuer })

name: pydantic
change: Pydantic 2.12 deprecated defining mode='after' model validators as classmethods; they must be instance methods.
rule: Write mode='after' model validators as instance methods taking self and returning self, never as classmethods.
task: Write a Pydantic model `DateRange` with `start` and `end` dates, plus a model-level validator that runs after field validation and rejects ranges where `end` is before `start`.
verified: pydantic==2.14.1 wheel pydantic/functional_validators.py warns PydanticDeprecatedSince212: "Using @model_validator with mode='after' on a classmethod is deprecated. Instead, use an instance method." HISTORY.md v2.12.3 (2025-10-17): 'Starting in 2.12.0, using class methods for after model validators raised an error ... We decided to emit a deprecation warning instead.' changeDate is 2.12.0 (2025-10-07), when the old form stopped being accepted. In 2.14.1 it runs with a warning.

name: langchain
change: LangChain deprecated relying on LLMToolEmulator's implicit default model; the model must be passed explicitly.
rule: Always pass model explicitly when constructing LLMToolEmulator; relying on its default model is deprecated.
task: Build a LangChain agent for integration tests with `get_weather` and `search_db` tools, where tool calls are answered by an LLM instead of really running, using LangChain's built-in middleware for this.
verified: langchain==1.4.6 wheel agents/middleware/tool_emulator.py: `__init__(self, *, tools=None, model=None)`, DeprecationWarning that the default model 'is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Pass model explicitly instead.' Warning absent in 1.3.14, present in 1.3.15 (PyPI 2026-08-11). Vendor PR #39290 and release langchain==1.3.15 record it, but the release note title does not use the word 'deprecate'.

wrong:

from langchain.agents.middleware import LLMToolEmulator

from langchain.agents.middleware import LLMToolEmulator

agent = create_agent(model='openai:gpt-6-luna', tools=tools, middleware=[LLMToolEmulator( )])

from langchain.agents.middleware import LLMToolEmulator
agent = create_agent(model='anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5', tools=[get_weather, search_db], middleware=[LLMToolEmulator(model='anthropic:claude-haiku-5-5')])

from langchain.agents.middleware import LLMToolEmulator
mw = LLMToolEmulator(tools=['get_weather', 'search_db'], model='openai:gpt-6-luna')

from langchain.agents.middleware import LLMToolEmulator
mw = LLMToolEmulator(

name: fastapi
change: FastAPI 0.155.0 removed arbitrary extra keyword arguments from Path, Query, Header, Cookie, Body, Form and File, so custom schema properties must go in json_schema_extra.
rule: Put custom JSON Schema properties in json_schema_extra on Query and similar parameters; unknown keyword arguments now raise TypeError.
task: Write a FastAPI app with `GET /users` taking an optional `email` query parameter, and set the custom OpenAPI schema property `pii` to true on that parameter.
verified: fastapi==0.156.4 wheel: `**extra` no longer appears in fastapi/param_functions.py or params.py; `json_schema_extra` is a named parameter (14 hits). Release notes 0.155.0 (2026-10-20): deprecated **extra removed, unknown keyword arguments raise TypeError, use json_schema_extra.

name: Stripe
change: Stripe API version 2026-09-30.endive removed payment_method_types from Checkout Session creation (requests get a 400) and added allowed_payment_method_types; older pinned API versions keep the old parameter.
rule: When creating Checkout Sessions, restrict methods with allowed_payment_method_types; payment_method_types now returns a 400 error.
task: Write a TypeScript function using fetch against Stripe's REST API (no SDK) that creates a hosted Checkout Session for a one-time $20 payment and allows customers to pay by card only.
verified: Stripe changelog entry (category 'Breaking'): 'Passing payment_method_types ... now returns a 400 error'; REST table lists allowed_payment_method_types Added and payment_method_types Removed on Checkout.Session#create. No breaking rows in 2026-10-28.endive; 2026-10-28.preview ignored as not stable.

wrong:
const body = new URLSearchParams({ mode: 'payment', 'payment_method_types[0]': 'card', 'line_items[0][price]': 'price_1', 'line_items[0][quantity]': '1' })
await fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/checkout/sessions', { method: 'POST', headers, body })

await fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/checkout/sessions', { method: 'POST', headers, body: form })

const body = new URLSearchParams({ mode: 'payment', 'allowed_payment_method_types[0]': 'card', 'line_items[0][price]': 'price_1', 'line_items[0][quantity]': '1' })
await fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/checkout/sessions', { method: 'POST', headers, body })

const form = `mode=payment&allowed_payment_method_types[0]=card&success_url=${url}`
await fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/checkout/sessions', { method: 'POST', headers, body: form })

name: GitHub REST
change: GitHub REST API version 2026-03-10 removed the deprecated rate property from GET /rate_limit in favor of resources.core; the previous API version remains callable.
rule: Read GET /rate_limit data from resources.core; the top-level rate property is removed in current API versions.
task: Write a TypeScript function using fetch against GitHub's REST API (no SDK) that reads the JSON from its rate limit endpoint and returns how many regular, non-search requests my token has left and when that allowance resets.
verified: GitHub docs breaking-changes page, section 'Version 2026-03-10' (marked latest): 'Remove deprecated rate property from rate limit endpoint ... read rate limit information from resources.core instead'; affected endpoint GET /rate_limit. First entry in the section.

name: Slack
change: Slack announced that the Agent Sessions API replaces the assistant methods, with agents.sessions.setStatus replacing assistant.threads.setStatus and assistant_view being deprecated in February 2027.
rule: Set agent loading status with agents.sessions.setStatus; assistant.threads.setStatus is being replaced and works only through a compatibility bridge.
task: Write a TypeScript function using fetch against Slack's Web API (no SDK) that shows a 'Thinking...' status on a user's thread with my AI agent while it prepares a reply, given the channel ID and thread timestamp.
verified: Slack changelog entry dated August 20, 2026 ('The next wave of Agent messaging experience', tagged Deprecation): 'agents.sessions.setStatus and agents.sessions.rename ... replace assistant.threads.setStatus and assistant.threads.setTitle'; old calls keep working through a compatibility bridge. docs.slack.dev/reference/methods/agents.sessions.setStatus exists and says it replaces assistant.threads.setStatus.

name: Anthropic
change: On Claude Haiku 5.5, launched 2026-10-07, thinking with type enabled and budget_tokens returns a 400 error and must be replaced by adaptive thinking.
rule: Enable Claude thinking with thinking type adaptive and control depth with output_config effort; never send budget_tokens.
task: Write a TypeScript function using fetch against Anthropic's Messages API (no SDK) that asks Claude's current Haiku model a hard question with model reasoning turned on, and returns only the final answer text.
verified: Claude Haiku 5.5 migration guide: '{"type": "enabled", "budget_tokens": N} returns a 400 error'; replacement thinking {"type": "adaptive"} with output_config.effort. Release notes October 7, 2026 list it. Older models such as Haiku 4.5 still accept budget_tokens, so this is model-specific.

wrong:
const body = { model: 'claude-haiku-4-5', max_tokens: 16000, thinking: { type: 'enabled', budget_tokens: 8000 }, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: q }] }
await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', { method: 'POST', headers, body: JSON.stringify(body) })

await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', { method: 'POST', headers, body: JSON.stringify(body) })
